selection: validation FP at zero lost candidate positives, then validation BCE, then earliest epoch
threshold: minimum positive validation score minus 0.000012; inclusive >= decision
blend_selection: validation FP at zero lost positives, then smaller CNN weight
test_policy: Freeze both models and blends before a separate single test evaluation per experiment; no test-driven changes.
test_reuse: Retrospective: cohort-v1 test results were already exposed before this experiment. This is not a new sealed test.
mixed_policy: Use only original labels/split.json real train cases with exact archived-detector candidate IDs, fingerprints and features; preserve all prior exposure and reject mismatches. No labels or original caches changed.
geometry_augmentation: disabled: cached 2.5D planes lack translated off-plane content
hu_augmentation: disabled for caches lacking verified per-case HU normalization scale; CT-only blur is used
eligibility_boundary: Archived corpus predates organizer-confirmed 2 mm origin diameter. No relabelling, retuning or compatibility claim with current production source.
